text:
```yaml
name: Close Stale PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Daily at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-stale-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go for gh CLI
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Authenticate with GitHub
        run: echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | gh auth login --with-token -

      - name: Get list of open PRs
        id: get_prs
        run: |
          gh pr list --state open --json number,author.login,labeled -q '.[] | select(.author.login != "jdx" and (.labeled == [] or .labeled[].name != "keep-open")) | {number}' > pr_numbers.json

      - name: Close stale PRs
        if: steps.get_prs.outputs.number != ''
        run: |
          jq -r '.[] | "gh pr close --pr $PR_NUMBER"' pr_numbers.json | bash

      - name: Post close comment
        if: steps.get_prs.outputs.number != ''
        run: |
          jq -r '.[] | "gh pr edit --pr $PR_NUMBER --add-label stale --comment \"This PR has been closed due to inactivity. If you believe this PR should not have been closed, please reopen it.\""' pr_numbers.json | bash
```
